title: How Business Central 2026 Improves Item Variant Management with Pictures and Attributes.
summary: Business Central 2026 adds pictures and variant-level attributes to item variants, enabling faster product identification and more accurate product information management. This helps organizations with multiple product variations reduce errors and maintain better inventory data.
key_points: Item variants can now have their own pictures for visual identification, supporting import, take picture, export, and delete operations
Attributes can be defined at the variant level so each variant maintains distinct values for characteristics like color, size, material, and capacity
Variant-level attributes automatically inherit from parent item attributes, reducing setup effort and maintaining data consistency
A new Update Variant Attributes action synchronizes attribute values from items to variants to keep information aligned across the product catalog

quotes.text: Users can visually distinguish products instead of relying only on codes and descriptions.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core benefit of variant pictures for improving usability and reducing selection errors

quotes.text: Each variant can maintain information specific to that version of the product.
quotes.why_it_matters: This clarifies how variant-level attributes enable variant-specific product information management
